fact: As of 7 September 2026 no AI-specific statute, regulation or government strategy binding a developer or deployer had been identified for Guinea-Bissau, and Lei n.º 5/2010 has no provision on automated decisions, synthetic content or AI risk.
title: Guinea-Bissau: AI, scraping, privacy, cybersecurity, communications, content-moderation, age-gating, and reuse law
